To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the antisera raised against the Tg conjugates of deoxyribonucleotides (dT, dG, dA, and dC) are highly specific for the respective nucleotide and the binding of these antisera with the ligand is characterized by a high affinity constant.
the Tg-dp conjugate is effective in elicitation of dpC specific antibodies and these antibodies are useful for the study of the interaction of dpC with its ligands.
the antibodies to deoxycydilate are specific, and the interaction of these antibodies with the ligand is enthalpy driven.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of dpC specific antibodies, the purification of the antibodies, and the characterization of their interaction with dpC.
the development of an immunoassay to detect the presence of dpC in biological fluids and to study the interaction of the antibodies with dpC.
the preparation of dpC conjugate of Tg, elicitation and purification of antibodies specific for dpC, and the study of interaction between the purified antibodies and ligands.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Tg-dpCligand is effective in elicitation of anti-dpCl antibodies and the antibodies so elicited can be separated into three distinct fractions.
Tg-dp-C conjugate is an effective immunogen and the antibodies formed are specific and effective in the detection of dpC.
Tg-dp-C is an effective hapten carrier for the production of anti-dp-C antibodies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Tg-dpClgG complex is the best hapten-protein conjugate for the production of dpC-specific antibodies and the anti-dpC-Fab fragments can be used as a model for the interaction between dpC and its binding protein.
the Tg-dp conjugate is a potent immunogen and dpC specific antibodies can be purified using affinity chromatography.

the dpC-Tg conjugate is effective for the formation of antibodies against dpC and that the antibodies thus formed are specific and bind to dpC in a manner consistent with the binding of the Fab fragments of the antibodies to the ligand.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hapten-carrier conjugates of deoxycytidine monophosphate (dCMP) and deoxycytosine (dC) can also be used to elicit anti-dpC antibodies.
the Tg-dp conjugate of the carrier protein is more effective than BSA-dpC in eliciting antibodies specific to dp, and that these antibodies can be purified on dpC affinity column.
Tg-dp C conjugate is an effective immunogen for eliciting antibodies specific to dp C and that these antibodies can be purified using dpC affinity columns.
